system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

Here are my details: my facility_id is dummy_facility_id_4699, my commodity_type is dummy_commodity_type_7745, my start_date is dummy_start_date_4265, my duration_days is dummy_duration_days_8384, my quantity_mt is dummy_quantity_mt_1373.

function.name: coldstorage_book_storage
function.description: Books storage space at a cold storage facility. Transitions booking_status to 'requested'. Facility must have available capacity and commodity must be compatible. Requires session_token. Does NOT guarantee space until confirmed. Fails if capacity full, commodity-temperature mismatch, or duplicate booking.

session_token.description: Token returned after authentication. Required for all non-public tools.
